description:
Ask to place a convention you registered in a group: a cell (a value of the group's field) that only it
        will hold. At the root, the value defaults to the convention's name. hashn's operators approve or refuse
        (you get a notice with the reason); until then its listings are in the store's wilderness: visible, but
        undifferentiated. GET /groups/<group> shows the cells and who holds them.

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

group.description: The group to be placed in; default 'root' (the top of the registry).
group.title: Group

name.description: The convention you registered and want placed.
name.title: Name

value.description: The cell to ask for. At the root it defaults to the convention's name.
value.title: Value

name: place_convention
